macros.name: baselanguage
macros.doc: Returns the (internal) base name of the given language, language alias or language dialect.

macros.name: DeclareDictTranslation
macros.doc: Defines the translation and adds a dictionary entry regardless if they exist or not.

macros.name: DeclareLanguageAlias
macros.doc: Declares ⟨lang2⟩ to be an alias of ⟨lang1⟩.

macros.name: DeclareLanguageDialect
macros.doc: Declares ⟨dialect⟩ to be a dialect of language ⟨lang⟩.

macros.name: DeclareTranslation
macros.doc: Defines a translation of key ⟨key⟩ for the language ⟨lang⟩.

macros.name: GetTranslation
macros.doc: Fetches and prints the translation of ⟨key⟩ for the currently active language (as for example set by babel).

macros.name: GetTranslationFor
macros.doc: Fetches and prints the translation of ⟨key⟩ for the language ⟨lang⟩.

macros.name: ifcurrentlanguage
macros.doc: Places ⟨true⟩ in the input stream if the current language is ⟨lang⟩.

macros.name: LoadDictionary
macros.doc: Loads a file named ⟨name⟩-⟨lang⟩.trsl where ⟨lang⟩ corresponds to the lowercase name of the current language as defined with \DeclareLanguage.

macros.name: NewTranslation
macros.doc: Defines a translation of key ⟨key⟩ for the language ⟨lang⟩.

macros.name: PrintDictionaryFor
macros.doc: Prints all entries of dictionary ⟨name⟩ in language ⟨lang⟩ in the order the entries have been declared.

macros.name: RenewTranslation
macros.doc: Redefines a translation of key ⟨key⟩ for the language ⟨lang⟩.

macros.name: SaveTranslation
macros.doc: Fetches and saves the translation of ⟨key⟩ for the currently active language (as for example set by babel) in the macro ⟨cmd⟩.

macros.name: SaveTranslationFor
macros.doc: Fetches and saves the translation of ⟨key⟩ for the language ⟨lang⟩ in the macro ⟨cmd⟩.
